status: draft: judged by Claude from each node's meaning; no user testing yet; sensitivity test to follow

tiers.name: What it means for me
tiers.asks: where, and maybe how big; other answers assumed, shown and changeable

tiers.name: What it could hold
tiers.asks: every setup question; then programs, arrangement, comparison

rule: every node runs in every tier; a tier sets what is asked and shown; facts are never switched off
tier_note: node tier = the first template that shows it: 'resident' (every template), 'arch' (Architecture and Engineering), 'full' (Engineering only), 'arch_only' (Architecture only). Community dropped 3 Nov 2026 (J.B.); Municipal not built yet.

parcel.why: where: the one thing a resident always gives

loading_need.why: how many loading spaces the zone asks for

roof_equipment_rule.why: what may stand on the roof above the height limit

storey_min.why: the lowest storey heights the zone allows

zoned_land.why: how much of the city a data centre is allowed on

industrial_jobs.why: jobs on that land: not in the tool yet

programs_nearby.why: libraries, community centres and recreation close to the lot

site_grade.why: how high the ground is, for the entrance and the height

hub_layout.why: how the Emergency hub is laid out on this lot

room_widths.why: whether each room is wide enough to use

t_reach.why: whether every room is reached the right way

dead_ends.why: how far a corridor runs past its last two-way point

fire_separations.why: how long walls and floors hold back a fire

travel_distance.why: how far anyone walks to an exit

exit_separation.why: whether the exits are far enough apart

egress_doorways.why: whether large rooms have two doors far enough apart

plant_clearances.why: the clear space the plant needs around it

building_height.why: how tall the building is, measured as the bylaw says

step_free_entry.why: whether the front door is step-free

chiller_winter_range.why: whether the chiller works in a design winter (the maker's stated range)

typology_spec_rules.why: rules a typology spec will apply: spec, not live yet

heat_cascade_spec_rules.why: rules the Heat cascade spec will apply: spec, not live yet

community_pool_spec_rules.why: rules the Community pool spec will apply: spec, not live yet

hub_small_lot_rules.why: rules for the Emergency hub on a small lot: spec, not live yet

site_trees.why: trees around the lot: data ready, white model not built yet

start_case.why: new, shared, retrofit or leased: assumed for residents, shown and changeable

receptors.why: who is close enough to hear it

zone.why: what the land is zoned for

cooling_type.why: drives heat, water and sound; assumed for residents
cooling_type.sens: moves size fit by up to 15%; moves noise level by up to 3.5 dB; moves component space by up to 25%

plant_schedule.sens: moves noise level by up to 3.0 dB

massing.why: how big it looks (moved to residents, 19 Oct)

host_building.why: the building it would sit in

server_floor.sens: moves size fit by up to 100%; moves floor area by up to 69%

envelope.why: what the zone lets it be

hall_area.sens: moves size fit by up to 41%; moves floor area by up to 37%

size_fit.why: how big a data centre fits here

cooling_units.why: the units on the roof or in the yard

heat_pumps.why: the heat pumps that lift the heat

hr_plant_room.why: the room the heat plant needs

power_allocation.why: whether and on what terms it gets power

refuge_services.why: what a refuge needs: washrooms, showers, water

crisis_events.why: what the refuge is for in each crisis

it_load_share.why: why the load running is below capacity

plant_weight.why: engineering: whether plant can sit above people

liquid_capture.sens: moves heat delivered by up to 43%; moves homes heated by up to 43%; moves lcoh by up to 29%

cop.sens: moves heat delivered by up to 15%; moves homes heated by up to 15%; moves lcoh by up to 11%

pue.sens: moves size fit by up to 11%; moves it load actual by up to 10%; moves grid co2 by up to 10%

spare_capacity.why: power it could lend the grid

flexible_load.why: power it could shift off the peak

water_behind_electricity.why: water used to make its power

visibility.why: what is seen from the street

fuel_on_site.why: fuel kept on site: amount and type only, never location

receiver_demand.why: how much heat the receiver needs
receiver_demand.sens: moves homes heated by up to 15%; moves lcoh by up to 18%

deprivation.why: who lives in the affected area

receivers_nearby.why: buildings nearby that could use the heat

price_floor.why: lowest price the operator could take

window.why: whether a price both accept exists

risk_term.why: what if the data centre leaves

affordability.why: what heat would cost a household

standoff.why: fence and setback at the street

noise_limit.why: the noise rule that protects neighbours

lrmc_bc.why: cost of new power to BC

tradeoffs.why: the trade-offs, in each tier's words

heat_plume_dT.why: warmer air near the cooling units

air_permit_trigger.why: whether an air permit is needed

homes_heated_2050s.why: homes its heat could warm in the 2050s

water_restriction_rule.why: what a drought would ask of it

refuge_after_quake.why: whether it could shelter people after an earthquake

heat_value_split.why: who keeps the value of the heat

ev_repay.why: how much an EV port must sell to repay itself

pv_lcoe.why: what rooftop solar costs per MWh

clean_power_price.why: what new clean power costs and who can buy it

stormwater_volume.why: rain held back from the sewers

snowmelt_area.why: sidewalks kept clear by its heat

arch_program_catalogue.why: the programs a site could hold

arch_heat_lift.why: whether a program can take the heat directly

arch_rules.why: the rules an arrangement passes or fails

arch_dc_hall.why: how much hall each MW needs

arch_ratios.why: how the lot and the floor are split
